description: This script processes input and PID files, reads their contents, computes a SHA-256 digest of the input file, and writes combined data to an output file. It appears to be used for generating or manipulating payload data with associated process identifiers.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input and optional PID files, computes SHA-256 hash of input, and writes combined data to an output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and orchestrates file processing by calling create_output.
